lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is widest at the mid-section and progressively more compact toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A distinct Y-shaped bifurcation is present on the third stripe from the posterior, splitting at the lower mid-flank position.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripes 4 and 5 from the anterior exhibit visible discontinuities, appearing as fragmented dashed segments; the first two anterior stripes terminate before reaching the ventral torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: 6 distinct white spots located on the lower haunch and upper hind limb, arranged in a low-density cluster.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the upper hind limb exhibit linear alignment in a diagonal trajectory pointing towards the tarsal joint.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white facial markings including a spot on the lower cheek and a white chevron-like horizontal band between the eyes.
